l13.label: Independent elective
l13.requires: An L01 project and model. This module prepares Search, embeddings, and an index, which also provide the foundation for L14.

l14.label: Prerequisites required
l14.requires: The Search service and index from L13, or equivalent administrator-provided resources. Required for L20 Hosted Optimizer and only the optional live Hosted deployment in L22.

l15.label: Independent elective
l15.requires: A basic project/model, administrator ownership receipt, and separate MAF environment. Single/two-role comparison makes at most three model calls. A2A is separate; only optional Hosted deployment needs L14.

l16.label: Independent elective
l16.requires: A basic project, chat and embedding deployments, and access to supported Memory features. No other advanced module is required.

l17.label: Separate feature paths
l17.requires: A routine can run independently with the server-side prompt agent from L05. The long-running Hosted path requires L14.

l18.label: Independent elective
l18.requires: The base environment and the models and permissions for your chosen Content Understanding or Code Interpreter path. Preparing the synthetic receipt also works locally.

l19.label: Independent elective
l19.requires: The base environment, a supported Voice/Speech model and region, and device permissions. No other advanced module is required.

l20.label: Separate feature paths
l20.requires: Read L08's single instruction comparison first. Local training-data preparation is independent; Hosted Optimizer and real training are optional and require separate approval and prerequisites.

l21.label: Independent elective
l21.requires: Use Python for the local access/cache repair, then complete the synthetic design. Actual access/network inspection needs read permissions; changes require an administrator and separate approval.

l22.label: Run after source setup
l22.requires: Use L01's local environment and sources for synthetic CI failure/repair and release/rollback design. L14 is needed only for optional live Hosted deployment; repeated evaluation and Optimizer are not required.

l23.label: Independent elective
l23.requires: A supported Foundry Local device or the relevant Fabric/Work IQ licenses and permissions. These electives are independent of other advanced modules.

l24.label: Independent elective
l24.requires: Repair a synthetic request contract with Python. No existing Classic environment is needed; real migration requires a separately approved environment.
